spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अमति)
1 To go, to go to or towards.
2 To serve or honour.
3 To sound.
10th cl. (अमयति)
To afflict with sickness or pain from disease.

ind. (-अम्)
1

Quickly.
2

Little.
mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Unripe, (as fruit, &c.)
m. (-मः)
Sickness.
E.
अम to go or to be sick. अच् aff.

ind.
1 With, together with.
2 Near.
f. (-मा)
Day of conjunction or new moon.
E.
अ neg. माङ् to measure, क्विप् affix, and टाप् fem. do.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Raw, undressed, unripe.
2 Unbaked, unannealed.
m. (-मः)
1 Sickness, disease.
2 Constipation, passing hard and unhealthy excretions.
3 Grain freed from the chaff.
E.
अम to be sick, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Inauspicious, unlucky, evil.
n. (-लं)
Inauspiciousness, ill luck.
m. (-लः)
The castor oil plant.
E.
अ neg. and मङ्गल auspicious: the wood has no sap, and is useless.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Inauspicious, unlucky, productive of evil.
E.
अ neg. मङ्गल्य auspicious.

m. (-ण्डः)
The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis.)
E.
अ neg. मडि to adorn, and अच् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
The castor oil plant.
E.
आङ् dim. मडि to adorn, अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unadorned.
E.
अ neg. मण्डित adorned.

m. (-तः)
1 Sickness, disease.
2

Death.
3

Time.
E.
अम to be sick, and अतच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Sober, not inebriated.
2 Sane, not mad.
E.
अ neg. मत्त crazy.

Time.
2

The moon.
3 A cheat, a rogue.
f. (-तिः)
Unconsciousness, ignorance, absence of knowledge or intention.
E.
अम to go, and अति Uṇādi affix, or अ neg. मति understanding.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Unconscious, unintentional.
E.
अमति ignorance, पूर्व्व before.

n. (-त्रं)
A vessel, a utensil.
E.
अम to go, अत्रन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
1 Not whole or entire.
2 Not elementary.
E.
अ neg. मात्र whole, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Unenvious, charitable.
E.
अ neg. मत्सर envious.

f. (-निः)
A road.
E.
अम to go, अनि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Not to be regarded, inadmissible, unknowable. Also अमननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं).
E.
अ neg. मन्तव्य or मननीय to be regarded.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Unmanly.
E.
अ neg. मनुष्य a man.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्यी-ष्यं)
Superhuman.
E.
अ neg. मानुष्य human.

f. (-ता)
Unmanliness.
E.
तल् added to the last: also with त्व, अप्तनुष्यत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unthought of, unknown.
E.
अ neg. मनोगत thought of.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Disagreeable, disliked.
E.
अ neg. मनोज्ञ agreeable.

Disapproved.
2

Reprobate.
E.
अ neg. मनस् the mind, नीत led.

m. (-गः)
Inattention.
E.
अ neg. मनोयोग attention.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Inattentive.
E.
अ neg. मनोयोगिन् attentive.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Disagreeable, displeasing, unattractive.
E.
अ neg. मनोहर pleasant. So अमनोरम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) and अमनोहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि).

mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं)
Unentitled to, or unaccompanied by holy texts, as a Śūdra, a female, certain ceremonies, &c.
E.
अ neg. मन्त्र a text of the Vedas.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unentitled to, or unaccompanied by holy texts.
E.
अ neg. मन्त्र a text, कन् added.

m. (-न्दः)
A tree. (E. अम sickness, and द from दो to cut, or destroy.)
mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
1 Fierce, violent.
2 Active.
E.
अ neg. मन्द tardy or dull.

m. (-मः)
One of the Jaina saints of a future age.
mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Devoid of all selfish or worldly attachment or desire.
E.
अ neg. and मम mine.

f. (-ता)
Disinterestedness, indifference.
E.
अमम and तल् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Disinterestedness, philosophy, stoicism.
E.
अमम and त्व aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A deity, an immortal.
2 A plant, (Heliotropium indicum.) See अस्थिसंहार.
3 Also, (Euphorbia tirucalli, &c.)
4 Quicksilver.
f. (-रा)
1 The residence of

INDRA.
2

A house post.
3 The womb.
4 The umbilical cord.
5 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) See गुडूची.
6 Bent grass, (Agrostis linearis.)
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Immortal.
E.
अ neg. and मर what dies, from मृ and अच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
What cannot die, immortal.
E.
अ neg. मरणीय perishable.

f. (-ता)
Immortality.
E.
तल् added to the last; also अमरणीयत्वं.

f. (-ता)
Immortality.
E.
अमर and तल् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Immortality.
E.
अमर and त्व aff.

m. (-रुः)
Name of a tree, (Pinus longifolius.)
E.
अमर, and दारु a tree.

m. (-जः)
A Brahman who lives by attending a temple or idol.
E.
अमर a god, and द्विज a Brahman.

m. (-तिः)
INDRA.
E.
अमर, and पति lord; also similar compounds, as अमराधिपतिः, अमरेशः, &c.

m. (-ष्पः)
A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
अमर, and पुष्प a flower; also with कन् added, अमरपुष्पकः.

f. (-का)
A kind of anise, (Anethum sowa.)
E.
अमर perpetual, and पुष्पिका having flowers.

m. (-र्त्ता)
INDRA.
E.
अमर, and भर्तृ lord.

n. (-कं)
Heaven, the abode of the gods.
E.
अमर, and लोक world.

f. (-ता)
Heaven.
E.
तल् added to अमरलोक.

f. (-स्त्री)
An Apsarā, or nymph of heaven.
E.
अमर, and स्त्री a female.

f. (-ना)
A nymph of INDRA'S heaven.
E.
अमर, and अङ्गना a female.

m. (-द्रिः)
Mount Sumeru or Meru.
E.
अमर a deity, and अद्रि a mountain; being the residence of the gods.

f. (-गा)
The heavenly Ganges.
E.
अमर, and अपगा river.

f. (-ती)
The capital of INDRA.
E.
अमर a deity, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Calm, without wind.
E.
अ neg. मरुत wind.

m. (-शः)
INDRA the king of the gods.
E.
अमर, and ईश lord.

m. (-रः)
INDRA.
E.
अमर, and ईश्वर chief.

m. (-र्त्यः)
A deity.
mfn. (-र्त्यः-र्त्या-र्त्यं)
Immortal, divine.
E.
अ neg. मृ to die, क्यप् aff.

n. (-नं)
The heaven of INDRA, or Svarga, a kind of Mohammedan paradise.
E.
अमर्त्य a deity, and भुवन a world.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unthreshed, unsubdued, not trodden down.
E.
अ neg. मर्द्दित trampled on.

f. (-दा)
1 Impropriety of conduct.
2 Disrespect.
E.
अ neg. मर्य्यादा limit.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Anger, passion.
2 Impatience, impetuosity.
E.
अ neg. मृष to bear with, घञ् aff.

m. (-र्शः)
Advice, counsel.
E.
आङ् before मृश to advise, affix घ्यञ्.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Wrath or rage.
2 Impatience.
E.
अ before मृष to bear, affix घञ्, the prefix made long: also अमर्ष.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Passionate, wrathful.
E.
as before, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Rubbing, wiping.
2 Anger.
E.
आङ् before मृष to rub, &c. युच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Hasty, impetuous, impatient.
2 Wrathful, passionate.
E.
अमर्ष and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-र्षी-षिणी-र्षि)
1 Passionate, wrathful.
2 Impetuous.
E.
अमर्ष and इनि aff.

n. (-लं)
Talc.
f. (-ला)
1 The goddess

LAKṢMI.
2

Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
3 The umbilical cord.
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Clean, pure.
2 White.
E.
अ neg. and मल dirt.

mf. (-त्री-त्रिणी)
The wild goose.
E.
अमल white or grey, and पतत्रिन् a bird.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Clean, pure.
E.
अ neg. मलिन dirty.

Time.
2

Stupidity.
3

Disease.
E.
अम to go, or be sick, and अस Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Harsh, hard.
2 Violent, intense.
E.
अ neg. मसृण soft.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Headless.
E.
अ neg. मस्तक the head.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Feeble, thin.
E.
अ neg. and मांस flesh. Also अमांसल.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Motherless.
E.
अ neg. मातृ a mother, कन् added.

m. (-त्यः)
A minister, a counsellor.
E.
अमा near, त्यप् aff.

m. (-त्यः)
1 A minister, a counseller, an adviser.
2 A general.
E.
see अमाव्य.

n. (-त्त्वं)
1 Spirit, spiritual essence.
2 Deficiency, defect.
E.
अ neg. मात्रवत् like elementary, त्व added.

n. (-नं)
Disrespect.
E.
अ neg. मन to mind, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Not human, animal.
2 Superhuman.
E.
अ neg. मानव mortal.

n. (-स्यं)
Pain. See आमनस्य.
E.
अ neg. मनस् the mind, and ण्यत् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
Pain.
E.
अ priv. मनस् the mind, यत् affix and the first vowel made long.

n. (-स्यं)
Pain.
E.
see आमनस्य, the antepen. being made long.

f. (-ता)
Modesty, humility.
E.
तल् added to अमानिन्, also with त्व, अमानित्वं.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Humble, modest.
E.
अ neg. मान pride, इनि affix. Also अमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं).

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Not human, animal, superhuman.
E.
अ neg. मानुष human.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
To be disrespected.
E.
अ neg. मान्य to be respected. Also अमाननीय and अमानितव्य.

f. (-सी)
The day of new moon.
E.
अमा with, मस to measure, अच् affix, and ङीप् fem. do or with घञ् affix; अमामासी.

f. (-सी)
Day of new moon.
E.
अमा with, and वस to abide, अच् affix; being with, or in the same quarter as the sun; also अमावासी.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Produced in the day of new moon.
E.
अमावास्या and अ aff.

f. (-स्या)
Day of conjunction or new moon.
E.
अमा with, (the sun and moon,) वस to abide, ण्यत् affix: or with the penult. vowel short, अमावस्या; also अमावसी, &c.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Occurring on the day of conjunction, &c.
E.
अमावास्य and अञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Produced on the day of new moon.
E.
अमावास्या and वुन् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 True, wise.
2 Sincere, guileless, free from error or deceit.
f. (-या)
1 Absence of delusion, knowledge of the truth.
2 Sincerity, honesty.
E.
अ neg. माया deceit, delusion.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Watery, formed from, or consisting of water, (as froth, &c.)
E.
अप् water, and मयट् affix; म is changed to प, and the fem. takes ङीप्^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312. note: missing virAma.

m. (-यः)
Sickness, disease.
n. (-यं)
A grass, (Costus.)
E.
अम to be sick, घञ् affix; आम, and य, from या to obtain.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
True, real, honest, void of trick or guile.
E.
अ neg. मायिक deceptive.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यी)
Acting without illusion or deceit.
E.
अ neg. मायिन् deceitful.

m. (-र्गः)
Want of a road.
mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं)
Without a road.
E.
अ neg. मार्ग a road.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unsought, not hunted after.
E.
अ neg. मार्गित sought.

Uncleansed.
2

Unadorned.
E.
अ neg. मार्ज्जित cleaned.

m. (-म्भः)
A water jar of unbaked clay.
E.
आम and कुम्भ a jar.

n. (-न्धि)
A bad and cadaverous smell, like that of raw meat or a burning corpse.
E.
आम raw, &c. and गन्धि smell.

nf. (-णं-णा)
1 Calling or calling to.
2 Courtesy, welcome, adieu, &c.
3 Inviting, invitation.
4

Interrogation.
5

The vocative case.
E.
आङ्, मत्रि to consult, affix युच्.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Asking, inviting, calling.
m. (-ता)
An inviter, an entertainer, especially of Brahmans.
E.
आङ् before मन्त्रि to counsel, causal form, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Invited, summoned, called.
E.
आङ्, मत्रि to consult, क्त aff.

n. (-सं)
Running at the nose, defluxion.
E.
आम and पीनस pituitary excretion.

m. (-सः)
Raw flesh.
E.
आम and मांस flesh.

m. (-शी)
A cannibal.
E.
आममांस and आशिन् who eats.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
1 Sick, diseased.
2 Affected with indigestion, dyspeptic.
E.
आमय, अव to go, and णिनि aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Dyspepsia, indigestion.
E.
आमयाविन् and त्व aff.

m. (-क्तः)
Dysentery.
E.
आम and रक्त blood.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Lasting for life, continuing till death.
E.
आङ् before मरण dying, and अन्त end, ठक् aff.

m. (-सः)
Imperfect chyme.
E.
आम and रस juice.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.)
m. (-कः)
Another plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.)
n. (-कं)
The fruit of the myrobalan.
E.
आङ् and मल to hold, वुन् affix, fem. ङीष् having all medicinal virtues.

mn. (-कः-कं)
Land near a mountain.

m. (-तः)
Constipation or torpor of the bowels, with flatulence and intumescence.
E.
आम and वात wind, the wind being supposed to be chiefly affected.

m. (-लः)
The cholic, pain arising from indigestion.

m. (-रः)
Dysentery, the excretion being mixed with hard and foetid matter.
E.
आम and अतिसार dysentery.

mfn. (-मात्)
Eating raw food.
E.
आम, अद to eat, ञिट् aff.

n. (-न्नं)
Undressed rice.
E.
आम and अन्न boiled rice.

m. (-यः)
The stomach.
E.
आम hardness of the faeces, &c. and आशय a station.
